:::{#def-proof-by-cases}
#### Proof by cases, proof by exhaustion

A **proof by cases**
[@wikipedia_proof_by_exhaustion],
also called a **proof by exhaustion**,
of a [proposition](#def-proposition) $Q$
lists [propositions](#def-proposition) $C_1, \ldots, C_k$,
the *cases*,
shows that at least one of them is true,
and proves $C_i \Rightarrow Q$ for each $i$.

:::
